newsitem.title: USA: Motor Club of America awarded B-plus rating.
newsitem.headline: Motor Club of America awarded B-plus rating.

text.p: Motor Club of America said Monday a subsidiary has been bestowed with a B-plus rating by A.M. Best Co, the insurance-industry rating agency.
The subsidiary, Motor Club of America Group, consists of Motor Club of America Insurance Co and Preserver Insurance Co.
The company said Best cited its continued favorable loss-ratio performance, improved capitalization and operating position for awarding the B-plus rating.
Best also noted the improved overall financial condition of the Group, including recent actions to reduce operating costs, the company said.
